lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You slept four hours and stood watch the other six. Trust the hull eventually.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: The voice on the comm gave three days. I don't have six hours to spend not moving.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then we move. If a dead operative's file survived anywhere, it's on Velorum.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Auction-world. They sell weapons up top, people down the bottom, and file the paperwork on both.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: You know it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I know it the way you know a wound. I swore I'd never set foot on that rock again.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: And here I am, plotting a course back for a man I scraped out of a coffin.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Why.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Because somebody has to find out who they buried in my casket. Might as well be the two of us.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then set the course.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Already set. Strap in. Velorum doesn't get gentler the closer you get.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Keep your hands where the crowd can't read them. Down here a drawn blade is a price tag.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: There are no sightlines. No exits I'd trust.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's the design. Built to make a newcomer feel small. Don't argue with it, just move.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Top tier sells what shines. The deeper you go, the worse what's for sale.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: And my records are at the bottom. We have three days.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: If they're anywhere, they're with a broker. Man trades in the paper that follows dead operatives.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Give me the name.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Resh. Smuggler. Runs the routes nobody's mapped, the ones under the cells.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They say he pulls children out of the markets, one at a time, for years.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: A smuggler with a conscience.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: A useful one, anyway. He'll be working the market row. Let me do the talking.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's him. Works the rail like he owns the floor. Easy. We're buyers. We talk.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Whatever you're selling, I'm not. Whatever you're buying, not from me. I'm working.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We need a route. Past a broker who won't open his glass. Word is you know the doors off the map.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: No. I know what you are. I've moved enough stock to know an operative when one's in my light.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: You're Program work. Men like me don't get found by men like you and walk away from it.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I'm not here for you.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: That's exactly what the last one said.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: I have people on every tier who owe me. I'm worth more to this market alive than you are worth getting me.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: So you walk, or this floor decides which of us it keeps.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Go on, then. You've got me. That's how it always ends with your kind.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: You find the one door I didn't have. So finish it and stop making me wait.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: ...What.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: You're free to go. I won't stop you.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Nobody with their boot on my neck takes it off. Not once, not in my whole life down here.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Men like you don't spare anybody. You use them up.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: You're a turned one. A Program weapon walking around with a salvage rat and an open hand.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: And yet.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: I pull children out of this market. One at a time. For every one I get out, the machine takes ten more.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: I came here for a route. That's all.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: I'm your way past that broker. But I don't want paying off and waved away. I want in.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: You're the first crack I've seen in a wall I've spent twenty years smuggling around.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: This is bigger than robbing a stall. This is the Dominion.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: I've known exactly who I'm crossing since I was younger than the kids I haul out of here.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: The difference today is who I'd be crossing it with. Best odds I've ever had.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: I caught a lead this morning. Movement through the cells, collateral being shifted.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: My routes run the same corridor as your broker's vault. We pick it up on the way.

lines.speaker: Broker
lines.text: Glass stays down. You talk to the grille or you talk to nobody. What do you want.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Operative records. A termination file. The designation is mine.

lines.speaker: Broker
lines.text: No. No, no. You're the kind of question that gets a man's stall burned with him inside it.

lines.speaker: Broker
lines.text: I don't have it. I never had it. Move on before somebody sees you standing here.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We can pay.

lines.speaker: Broker
lines.text: Money's not what gets you in. That vault wants trust, and I've got none to spend on you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: He's a wall. So we go around him.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Around how.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Resh already gave us the door. His routes run under this stall. Let's move.

lines.speaker: Enforcer
lines.text: Channel's supposed to be dead down here. Who's moving?

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: The collateral I tracked this morning. Same cage. Your records are still past it.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: If you're buyers, the auction's two tiers up. If you're something else, get it over with.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: The tag says Iris.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Say that again. Say the name again.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: ...Who is that. Who's on the channel.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Iris. It's your father. I've been scraping a dead field for six years to buy you back.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: They told me you stopped looking. They told me you signed me away.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: They lied. I never stopped. Not one night. I'm right above you.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Hold still. I'm cutting you loose.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: You're the one he came with. The operative. He's really up there.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: He never sat down. Go to him.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: I read systems. Locks, networks, the paper they keep on people. Take me to that vault.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: She's right. I can get you to the door. Getting through it is a different trade.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Iris. Stay between them. You come back up to me. You hear?

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: I hear you. I'm coming back. Let me earn the trip first.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Door's mine. Terminal's clear now that the muscle's down. Iris, it's yours.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Every one of these is a person. Dead operatives, jettisoned, then bought back here as salvage.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: The same trade that put me in front of Kessler. A box thrown out as garbage.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: I've spent my whole life pulling people out of a place that's built on bodies.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: ...There's one here under your designation. Filed with the dead. It's yours.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Read it.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: This is your termination order. Executed. Signed off.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: The killswitch discharged. Full sequence.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then why am I reading it?

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Because it didn't take. It fired into your skull, full discharge, and you just kept breathing.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Every one of you has this. A leash in the skull. Yours is the only one on record that failed.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Mine's the only one they've found that failed.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: ...You think there are more of you. Ones that slipped and nobody caught it.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: A leash that broke once on me can break on others. The men who built it don't know that yet.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I pulled a man out of a coffin who'd already been executed. I didn't know nothing was ever supposed to come out of it.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Copy it. The file, and the others. Every leash in this room.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Copying. It'll take both of us a lifetime to read what's in here.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Then it's a good thing you found a crew. Door's clear. Let's get Kessler's girl home before this market notices what it just sold us for free.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: It's so quiet up here. I forgot quiet.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Six years I had a voice on a wire and a coffin where you should have been. Stand still.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Let me look at you with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: I told you I'd come back. I earned the trip.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Hold the moment. I came up that ramp with one more set of footsteps than I should have.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: Stay put.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: ...No. No, you don't get to be down here. How did you get past me.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: You're Resh. You're the one who gets us out.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: You know my face.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I saw you on the floor. You weren't running. You were with them. So I followed.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: ...Is the loud part over? Up there. It's loud.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: ...That's a child. Resh, that is a child standing in my hold.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: She stowed away. Off the auction floor. She's market stock that walked off the shelf on her own legs.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'm not in the business of turning a child back toward a cage. Not on this ship.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Are you going to send me back.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Nobody puts you back. You stay with the ship. You stay where Kessler can see you.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: ...That's twice today you've done a thing your kind doesn't do.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then she stays. She stays aboard, with me, same as Iris. I have the room and I have the reason.

lines.speaker: Resh
lines.text: A salvage rat, a freed tech, a stowaway, and me. Hell of a manifest.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Get some rest. Velorum can keep the rest of it.
